mapper.select: SELECT ms.member_key, ms.stock_cd, ms.quantity AS hold_qty, ms.avg_price, si.current_price, overdue.overdue_amt FROM t_member_stock ms JOIN t_stock_info si ON ms.stock_cd = si.stock_cd JOIN ( SELECT sh.member_key, SUM(sh.settlement_amt - sh.net_amt) AS overdue_amt FROM t_settlement_his sh WHERE sh.leverage_yn = 'Y' AND sh.due_date < CURDATE() GROUP BY sh.member_key HAVING overdue_amt > 0 ) overdue ON ms.member_key = overdue.member_key WHERE ms.quantity > 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_trade_order o WHERE o.member_key = ms.member_key AND o.stock_cd = ms.stock_cd AND o.order_src_cd = 'MARGIN_CALL' AND o.order_status_cd = 'PENDING' ) ORDER BY overdue.overdue_amt DESC, ms.member_key LIMIT #{limit}
